newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-HARDING WILL PLEDGES SUPPORT FOR CHELSEA, BENFIELD.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-HARDING WILL PLEDGES SUPPORT FOR CHELSEA, BENFIELD.

text.p: The will of businessman Matthew Harding expresses the wish that continued support be given to both his insurance business Benfield and Chelsea Football Club, the executors said in a statement on Thursday.
Harding, chairman of Benfield, was killed in a helicopter crash on October22.
Chelsea is owned by Chelsea Village Plc of which Harding was vice chairman.
The executors said Harding's will had left his entire estate in a descretionary trust of which there are numerous beneficiaries.

"Matthew Harding has expressed his clear wish to the Trustees that they support, for as long as it is deemed apppropriate, both the Benfield Group and Chelsea," the statement said. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
